result: Taken at the opening price and valued at the close: spreads −2.2%, totals 0.0%, winners −1.6%

forecasts: Weekly point-spread moves, from momentum and injury news
result: Forecast R² 0.016; the injury features added nothing (0.013)
lesson: Its first backtest showed +16–27% at t > 4. That was a leak (it compared against future prices), caught by an adversarial review before anything was used.
